title: Whisker Venomspitter
html:
Noxious Whisker Venomspitter

Whisker Venomspitters are the ranged warriors of the Whisker ranks.

Race: Whisker

Class: Ranger

Tip: After other mobs are dealt with there are frequently some Venomspitters left. They fire slowly, and a good ranged attack will usually deal with them quickly.

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Whisker Venomspitter Poison Algernon
Crimson Whisker Venomspitter Fire Vergrim's Vexation, The Tomb of Singe, The Shadow's Embrace offs
Divine Whisker Venomspitter Divine Choppe's Shoppe,,The Mutanous Malaise
Poison Whisker Venomspitter Poison Vergrim's Vibation Plant
Toxic Whisker Venomspitter Poison Vergrim's Vexation. Mutant Mania
Noxious Whisker Venomspitter Poison The Widower's Nest
Frostbitten Whisker Venomspitter Ice Vergrim's Supply Depot
Ice Venomspitter Ice Ratsputin's Gulag offs
Frostbitten Blaster* Ice Ratsputin's Gulag

Notes

CAUTION: Poison based Venomspitters continue to emit fumes even after they are dead. You can lose health just by standing next to them. The fumes will disappear once the body disappears.

Specials

  • Frostbitten Blasters are bigger and larger versions of Venomspitters. They appear in a different skin. They really are a category of their own.
